subject: NPCServices.xml
claim: On r806919.Wizard_1_610, Root.wad NPCServices.xml has root class NPCServices (hash 849610977) with a 32-bit m_npcProximity float set to 500, one unresolved boolean property, and one unresolved 24840-bit service-list property whose values include Registrar and Training.
how_to_repeat: Build the repository's client and schemaprobe tools with the Windows preset.
Run `client types 849610977 --client <install>` and confirm the client names the unknown root class NPCServices.
Inspect the structured schema and value readings for class hash 849610977 without copying the temporary output into the repository.
evidence: The client tool names class hash 849610977 as NPCServices even though the generated type dump does not contain it.
The candidate schema contains m_npcProximity as a float and leaves property hashes 1348307606 and 1847846230 unresolved.
The NPCServices root has one 32-bit m_npcProximity value interpreted as 500, one 1-bit boolean value, and one 24840-bit unresolved value.
The unresolved service-list reading contains 29 labels, including Registrar and Training, alongside Shopping, Banking, Questing and other service labels.
disproof: A repeatable schemaprobe run on r806919.Wizard_1_610 that assigns a different root class or property shape to NPCServices.xml, or whose service-list reading contains neither Registrar nor Training, would refute this finding.
